description: Command-line tool for the Jex Clean Architecture template: create projects (jex new), scaffold features (jex scaffold), and run the build/test/database/infrastructure workflow of a generated solution (jex check, jex run, jex db, jex infra).

Contracts for Mokaterm plugins and modules: protocols, sessions, terminals, file systems, settings and the MokatermPlugin attribute. Plugins compile against it; the Mokaterm host supplies it at run time.
Builds a Mokaterm plugin: packs a Razor class library into a .mokaplugin with its manifest, its private dependencies, its static files and its themes, leaving out everything the host provides.
dotnet new template for Mokaterm plugins: an app tool, a System view page or a theme pack, each building into a .mokaplugin package.

Shared Blazor building blocks for Mokaterm plugins and modules: UI contributions, session views, editor and settings base classes, the settings fields, icons and the page interop helpers. Plugins compile against it; the Mokaterm host supplies it at run time.
JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP step provider for vouchfx — invokes a method and asserts on the result/error envelope.
